call_goal: Understand how Helio Health observes its patient-intake assistant today and who relies on that view

Yeah, so, um. We're a Datadog shop, basically, for everything. APM, logs, the whole thing. And when we stood up the intake assistant the, uh, the platform team just kind of extended that, so the orchestration service emits OTel spans and they land in Datadog next to everything else.

And then the prompt and the response we log to, I think it's a separate index? With a redaction step in front of it, because, you know, PHI. Somebody on the data engineering side set that up, I'd have to double-check the details.

Okay. And who's, like, who's in there looking at it, typically?

Mostly the on-call engineers, honestly. If latency spikes or the, uh, the model provider has a bad afternoon, that's where they go. The clinical content folks don't really go into Datadog. They, um, they review stuff a different way, they've got their own thing.
